scope: Anonymous aggregate joint temporal source/noise pilot; no target identifiers or individual signal measurements published

limits: First eligible sector only; not whole-sector combined source validation
Object/phase split from paired diagnosis, not an independent astrophysical validation sample
Three amplitude levels repeat a fixed linear model; deduplicate contrasts and brightness caps

Static positions/PRF, empirical covariance shrinkage/common OU and hyperparameter uncertainty remain
No complete host footprint exclusion, physical alternatives, timing or reliability qualification
summary.next_action: Investigate variable-mode temporal correlation and background mean inadequacy before source exclusions; do not widen intervals or declare misses as astrophysical false positives.
